channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Binance and Deribit cut SignalPlus API access
item.description: Binance and Deribit revoked SignalPlus API keys after a reported security issue, cutting automated trading access while saying their own systems were unaffected.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34 billion theft to fake job interview
item.description: Binance says attackers used a fake interview, malware and internal access to reach wallet signing systems, enabling $6.34 billion in unauthorized transfers.

item.title: Binance details $6.34 billion wallet-signing incident
item.description: Binance says attackers used its wallet-signing service to move $6.34 billion across networks; $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted, and it will cover losses.

item.title: Binance paused withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3bn through its hot-wallet signing service; withdrawals were paused as it revoked on-chain permissions and froze assets.

item.title: NEAR governance backs gradual cut to 1.6% issuance ceiling
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a 24-month plan to lower the token issuance ceiling to 1.6%, but a validator upgrade is still needed to activate it.

item.title: Securitize plans Stellar integration for tokenized assets
item.description: Securitize plans to add Stellar for issuing and managing tokenized financial products, giving asset managers another network option while product and launch dates remain open.

item.title: Four Checks Before Spending Bridged Tokens
item.description: Four checks help confirm that bridged tokens are the asset and chain you intend to use, and that the transaction can complete at an acceptable cost.

item.title: Binance reopens some withdrawals after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance reopened withdrawals for several major cryptocurrencies after a $6.3 billion theft, while security checks continue and other networks remain offline.

item.title: FBI ties $6B Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29; the group is shifting assets into ether as agencies seek to block laundering.

item.title: Binance reports $6.3B security breach, freezes $3B
item.description: Binance says a compromised DevOps laptop may have enabled $6.3 billion in unauthorized withdrawals; partners froze about $3 billion, and the exchange pledged to cover losses.

item.title: Binance suspends withdrawals after $6.3B hot-wallet hack
item.description: Binance says a hot-wallet breach cost about $6.3 billion and it has suspended withdrawals while it checks affected systems and replenishes stolen assets.

item.title: What SpookySwap lets users do with their tokens
item.description: SpookySwap lets wallet holders trade tokens, supply pool liquidity, stake BOO, farm incentives and bridge assets, with each route carrying a different risk.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade cuts finality to a 150ms target
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow, replacing its old validator voting system with a 150-millisecond finality target that could help apps settle payments sooner.

item.title: Binance investigates security issue as firms freeze $2.54B
item.description: Binance is investigating a reported security issue as crypto firms say they have frozen $2.54 billion, while the exchange has paused deposits and withdrawals.

item.title: Curve brings StableSwap to Stellar in first non-EVM launch
item.description: Curve has launched StableSwap on Stellar mainnet, its first native move beyond EVM chains, letting users build pools and trade closely correlated assets.

item.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD across its trading platforms
item.description: Coinbase added Ripple’s RLUSD on Oct. 28 across Prime, Exchange and its app, with three-network transfers and 1:1 dollar conversion widening access.

item.title: DTCC launches token service for $30 trillion in securities
item.description: DTCC launched a service for tokenized securities, with 20 firms signed up and 34 eligible assets worth about $30 trillion, according to CoinDesk.

item.title: Aviva puts £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple put a tokenized share class of the £22 billion sterling liquidity fund on XRPL, adding on-chain access while fund assets stay off-chain.

item.title: Aviva and Ripple put £22bn sterling fund shares on XRPL
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple have launched a tokenised share class of a £22bn sterling fund on XRP Ledger, adding on-chain access while the fund stays off-chain.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade cuts finality to about 150 milliseconds
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on October 21, replacing TowerBFT with validator vote certificates and targeting faster settlement while keeping wallets and fees unchanged.
